item.title: China adds Japanese organizations to export control list
item.description: Chinese authorities have added 20 Japanese organizations to a list of entities subject to export controls, tightening restrictions on the trade of dual-use goods, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Leyla Aliyeva and Alena Aliyeva visit boarding school and STEAM Center in Quba city
item.description: On February 24, Leyla Aliyeva and Alena Aliyeva paid a visit to the Quba district, where they toured local educational institutions and engaged with students and faculty members.

item.title: Leyla Aliyeva visits the family of Patriotic War Hero Shahin Allahyarov
item.description: On February 24, Leyla Aliyeva visited the family of Patriotic War Hero, Senior Warrant Officer of the State Border Service, the martyred Shahin Allahyarov.

item.title: “We Waited 33 Years”: emotional homecoming in Jabrayil’s Horovlu
item.description: In accordance with the instructions of President Ilham Aliyev, the Great Return to Azerbaijan’s liberated territories continues in a phased and systematic manner. As part of the latest stage of resettlement, 30 families — a total of 115 people — have been relocated to Horovlu village in the Jabrayil district.

item.title: Leyla Aliyeva becomes guest of beekeeper’s family in Guba
item.description: On February 24, as part of her visit to the Guba district, Leyla Aliyeva visited beekeeper Zafer Azizov at his home.

item.title: Leyla Aliyeva and Alena Aliyeva visit Juma Mosque
item.description: On February 24, Leyla Aliyeva and Alena Aliyeva visited the Juma Mosque as part of their trip to the Quba district, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan to ship another 4,500 tons of diesel fuel to Armenia
item.description: Azerbaijan plans to send another 4,500 tons of diesel fuel to Armenia by rail today, February 25, as part of an ongoing program of fuel product deliveries between the two neighboring countries, local reports say, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azeri Light oil prices decline in global energy markets
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude oil at Italy’s Augusta port has fallen by $1.34, or 1.83%, from the previous level, settling at $71.97 per barrel on a CIF basis, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Leyla Aliyeva attends Iftar ceremony in Quba
item.description: On February 24, Leyla Aliyeva attended an iftar ceremony in Quba together with families of martyrs and members of the local community.

item.title: Azerbaijan’s Deputy FM participates in UN Human Rights Council High-Level Segment
item.description: Elnur Mammadov, Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of Azerbaijan, visited Geneva from February 23 to 25, 2026, to participate in the high-level segment of the 61st session of the United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHRC), AzerNEWS reports.
